name: Scrapling Data
description: Serves live crypto, DeFi, stock and web data plus downloadable datasets to AI agents, paid per call with x402 USDC and with no API key required.

skills.name: List and Preview Datasets
skills.description: Lists the dataset catalog with prices and field names, and previews up to 10 real rows before purchase, via list_datasets and preview_dataset.

skills.name: Buy Datasets
skills.description: Downloads every row of a chosen dataset in JSON, JSONL, CSV or Markdown after a USDC payment, via buy_dataset, at the price shown in list_datasets.

skills.name: Crypto and DeFi Lookups
skills.description: Looks up coin prices, protocol TVL, pool stats and ranked DeFi yields via lookup_coin, lookup_protocol, lookup_pool and lookup_yields.

skills.name: Free Market Snapshots
skills.description: Returns free top coin prices, DeFi yields, and perp funding and open interest via free_crypto_top10, free_defi_top_yields and free_perps_dashboard.

skills.name: Scrape Web Pages
skills.description: Fetches a live web page and returns clean, LLM-ready Markdown with boilerplate stripped, via scrape_url, paid per page in USDC.

skills.name: E-commerce Price Data
skills.description: Returns a free e-commerce price and stock index teaser and paid live product lookups via free_ecom and ecom_product.
